description: Rails of workwear in three colours: black, industrial orange and a grey that used to be one of the other two. Coveralls by chest size, boots by the wall in stacked boxes, and a whole rack devoted to cold — parkas, thermals, the sort of hood that turns a face into a rumour. Everything here is heavy in the hand. A hand-lettered card on the counter reads NO REFUNDS ON ANYTHING YOU'VE SWEATED IN.
name: Layers — Shop Floor
